purpose: Shows one keyboard key (⌘, K, Esc, an arrow) in a shortcut hint or a navigation legend; KbdGroup spaces several keys as one shortcut.

notFor.case: A whole shortcut written as one string.

Default.visual: Surface/muted fill, Border/subtle edge, Content/secondary text.

notes: Spell out modifier names in an aria-label when the glyph alone is ambiguous.

openQuestions: Usage puts sm Kbd in tooltips, which sit on an inverse surface, but Kbd only has the Surface/muted look. Does it need an inverse treatment?
